evidence.detail: apply_rules_query() builds per-deck card inclusion/exclusion rules; no color-word detection exists
add_archetype_if_just_colors() checks for color words in archetype names for display purposes, but no enforcement logic exists anywhere
Issue author themselves is unsure of approach: 'An implicit rule against basics of the other colors? Something more sophisticated than that?'

triage.notes: This is a genuine feature request with open design questions: should enforcement block basics only, or any off-color card? Should it apply automatically to all archetypes or opt-in? An owner must decide the semantics before any implementation is meaningful.
